topic: How should transponder configurations balance spectral efficiency and quantum state purity when multiplexing classical/quantum signals in hybrid payloads?
response: To balance spectral efficiency and quantum state purity when multiplexing classical/quantum signals in hybrid payloads, transponder configurations should utilize techniques such as coherent detection to minimize noise addition. This can be achieved by optimizing the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and ensuring proper alignment of optical frequencies. Additionally, advanced modulation schemes like QPSK or 16-QAM can be employed to improve spectral efficiency while maintaining quantum state purity.
